title: Ordering 3/4, 5/7 and 7/10
caption: With equal-length bars the shaded lengths can be compared directly: 7/10 is shortest, then 5/7, then 3/4, as 98/140 < 100/140 < 105/140.
alt: Three bars of equal length: 7 of 10 parts shaded, 5 of 7 parts shaded and 3 of 4 parts shaded, the shading ending further right each time.
description: Each bar is one whole, cut into 10, 7 or 4 equal parts.
5/7: five of seven parts shaded, ending a little further right.
3/4: three of four parts shaded, the longest.
